properties.notes: Demolition of existing public house (Use Class A4) and construction of new, four storey plus basement mixed-used building comprising basement and ground floor drinking establishment (Use Class A4) with 8 residential units (x4 studio flats, x3 one bedroom flats and x1 two bedroom flat) (Use Class C3) on first, second and third floor levels with balcony amenity spaces and associated cycle and refuse storage.
